title: NebulaDNS Overview
description: NebulaDNS data plane, fleet health and the failover controller. All panels follow the variables above.

panels.title: Instances up
panels.description: Scrape targets currently up for the selected job/instance.

targets.expr: sum(up{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Instances down
panels.description: Scrape targets that are down. Any non-zero value: see the NebulaDNSDown runbook.

targets.expr: count(up{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Query rate
panels.description: Queries answered per second across the selection.

targets.expr: sum(rate(nebula_dns_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode=~"$rcode"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: p99 latency
panels.description: In-process query-to-response latency, 99th percentile. Excludes network time.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(nebula_dns_query_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode=~"$rcode"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: SERVFAIL ratio
panels.description: Share of answers that are SERVFAIL. An authoritative server should be ~0.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(nebula_dns_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode="SERVFAIL"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(nebula_dns_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: NXDOMAIN ratio
panels.description: Share of answers that are NXDOMAIN. A jump usually means a broken client or a missing record.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(nebula_dns_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode="NXDOMAIN"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(nebula_dns_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: REFUSED ratio
panels.description: Out-of-zone queries. High values mean clients use NebulaDNS as a resolver, a misrouted forwarder, or scanning.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(nebula_dns_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode="REFUSED"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(nebula_dns_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Drops / s
panels.description: Requests dropped before a response (malformed, rate limited, policy, overload, TSIG, ACL).

targets.expr: sum(rate(nebula_dns_dropped_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Queries by protocol
panels.description: UDP vs TCP. A TCP rise often follows truncated (TC=1) UDP answers.

targets.expr: sum by (proto) (rate(nebula_dns_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode=~"$rcode"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Queries by type
panels.description: Query mix by QTYPE (bounded label; unknown types are 'other').

targets.expr: sum by (qtype) (rate(nebula_dns_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode=~"$rcode"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Responses by rcode
panels.description: Answers by response code.

targets.expr: sum by (rcode) (rate(nebula_dns_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode=~"$rcode"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Queries by instance
panels.description: Load spread across instances. One instance at zero while others serve: check its listeners and routing.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(nebula_dns_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode=~"$rcode"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: In-process latency. Buckets span 1 µs to ~33 ms, so values above that read as the top bucket.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(nebula_dns_query_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode=~"$rcode"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(nebula_dns_query_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode=~"$rcode"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(nebula_dns_query_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode=~"$rcode"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Where queries land in the latency buckets over time.

targets.expr: sum by (le) (increase(nebula_dns_query_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode=~"$rcode"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: p99 by query type
panels.description: A single slow QTYPE points at a large RRset or truncation.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, qtype) (rate(nebula_dns_query_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode=~"$rcode"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: p99 by instance
panels.description: One slow instance usually means CPU contention on that host.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, instance) (rate(nebula_dns_query_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode=~"$rcode"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Non-NOERROR responses
panels.description: Everything that isn't a clean answer, by rcode.

targets.expr: sum by (rcode) (rate(nebula_dns_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode!="NOERROR", rcode=~"$rcode"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Drops by reason
panels.description: Requests dropped before a response. 'malformed' spikes are usually scanners or fuzzers.

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (rate(nebula_dns_dropped_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Instances
panels.description: One row per instance: build, scrape health, load, latency and error ratio.

targets.expr: max by (instance, version, commit) (nebula_build_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})
max by (instance) (up{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})
sum by (instance) (rate(nebula_dns_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode=~"$rcode"}[5m]))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, instance) (rate(nebula_dns_query_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode=~"$rcode"}[5m])))

(sum by (instance) (rate(nebula_dns_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype", rcode=~"SERVFAIL|FORMERR|NOTIMP"}[5m])) or sum by (instance) (rate(nebula_dns_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype"}[5m])) * 0) / sum by (instance) (rate(nebula_dns_queries_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", proto=~"$proto", qtype=~"$qtype"}[5m]))

panels.title: Scrape health
panels.description: Prometheus `up` per instance. Red bands are gaps where the target could not be scraped.

targets.expr: max by (instance) (up{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Serving state by hostname
panels.description: Controller decision per hostname. 'degraded' (both POPs down) pages per the DnsFailover runbook.

targets.expr: max by (hostname) (nebula_dns_failover_state{job=~"$failover_job", hostname=~"$hostname"})

panels.title: POP health
panels.description: Per-POP up/down after hysteresis.

targets.expr: max by (pop) (nebula_dns_failover_pop_up{job=~"$failover_job", pop=~"$pop"})

panels.title: Since DNS last changed
panels.description: Time since the controller last changed a record (failover or failback). Grows in steady state; apply errors show in 'DNS apply results'.

targets.expr: time() - max(nebula_dns_failover_last_success_unixtime{job=~"$failover_job"} > 0)

panels.title: Probe latency by POP
panels.description: Last health-probe latency per POP.

targets.expr: max by (pop) (nebula_dns_failover_probe_latency_milliseconds{job=~"$failover_job", pop=~"$pop"})

panels.title: State changes
panels.description: Serving-state changes per hostname. Frequent flapping: tune the hysteresis.

targets.expr: sum by (hostname) (changes(nebula_dns_failover_state{job=~"$failover_job", hostname=~"$hostname"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: DNS apply results
panels.description: Controller DNS writes by result. Any 'error' is worth a look.

targets.expr: sum by (result) (rate(nebula_dns_failover_dns_apply_total{job=~"$failover_job", hostname=~"$hostname"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Transitions since controller start
panels.description: Raw transition counters: which states each hostname moved between, and why. Resets when the controller restarts.

targets.expr: sum by (hostname, from, to, reason) (nebula_dns_failover_transitions_total{job=~"$failover_job", hostname=~"$hostname"})
